bio_short: Nolan Kido explores practical technology, thoughtful living, tournament poker, and creative work. His website brings together useful resources, clear explanations, and questions about meaning, attention, and everyday life.
bio_long: Nolan Kido builds useful tools and explores ideas through writing and visual storytelling. His personal website connects Technology, Living Well, Poker, and Creative Work. Living Well explores spirituality, practical wisdom, and ways technology can support ordinary life. Across the site, the emphasis is on curiosity, clear thinking, useful resources, and respect for different perspectives.
